posts.title: Penn State vs Northwestern
posts.headline: Northwestern opens Ryan Field by routing Penn State, 34-13
posts.dek: Caleb Komolafe ran for 188 yards. The Wildcats piled up 413 yards on the ground in an $875 million stadium. Penn State fans are already calling for Matt Campbell.
posts.angle: Northwestern 34, Penn State 13, in the first game at the new Ryan Field.

blocks.text: Northwestern beat Penn State 34-13 on Friday night in the first game at the new Ryan Field in Evanston. The Wildcats rushed for 413 yards. Caleb Komolafe ran for a career-high 188 yards and a touchdown. Joseph Himon II added 162 yards and two scores. Northwestern finished with 506 total yards and led from the start.
A new stadium, and a second straight loss

The building is the story sitting next to the score. Ryan Field was rebuilt on the same site, at a reported cost of $875 million. Northwestern (3-1, 1-1 in the Big Ten) scored 24 points in the first half and treated the opener like a statement after a 29-23 loss at Indiana the week before. Jackson Kleather’s 50-yard field goal, the first points of the night, was the longest by a Wildcat since 2002.

Penn State is in its first season under Matt Campbell. The Nittany Lions dropped a second straight conference game. Carson Hansen’s 8-yard run cut the lead to 10-7 in the first half. Chase Sowell’s touchdown late made it 31-13. Neither stopped the result. Reporting on Saturday said Penn State fans were already demanding Campbell’s job.
The final is 34-13. The yardage is 413 on the ground. The building is open. That is the night people are searching.

posts.title: France vs Italy
posts.headline: Italy hold France to 1-1 and spoil Zidane’s homecoming
posts.dek: Michael Olise scored the goal France are still talking about. Italy cancelled it. Zidane said his team deserved more, and that Italy defended well.
posts.angle: France 1, Italy 1. Olise scored. Italy would not leave.

blocks.text: France and Italy drew 1-1 in the Nations League. Michael Olise scored the goal that should have been the headline by itself. Italy cancelled it out. Zinedine Zidane’s first home night in charge of France ended level, and he said afterward that France deserved more and that Italy defended well.
The goal, and the answer

Olise’s strike is the clip. Italy’s reply is why the match is still being searched as a result rather than a highlight. Gianluigi Donnarumma is the other name attached to the night in the Spanish-language coverage of the same game: a goalkeeper who kept France from turning one moment into a win. The score the match reports agree on is France 1, Italy 1.

Zidane called it a homecoming that deserved a better ending. He also credited the opponent. Those two sentences are the manager’s account. The table will treat it as a point each. The search is treating it as the night France did not win.

posts.title: Pittsburgh vs Virginia Tech
posts.headline: Pitt survives in Blacksburg, 35-33, on a missed kick
posts.dek: John Love’s 36-yard try as time expired was ruled wide left. Virginia Tech fans thought it was good. Pitt is 5-0.
posts.angle: Pitt 35, Virginia Tech 33. The last kick is the argument.

blocks.text: Pitt beat Virginia Tech 35-33 on Friday night at Lane Stadium. The last play was a 36-yard field goal by Virginia Tech’s John Love as time expired. Officials ruled it no good, wide left. Love and the crowd behind the end zone thought it had gone through. Pitt left Blacksburg unbeaten.
How it got there

Pitt lost quarterback Heintschel to an injury and still won. Holden Geriner came off the bench and threw a touchdown. Ja’Kyrian Turner added a rushing score. The Panthers are 5-0 and 2-0 in the ACC, one of three unbeaten teams in the conference. Virginia Tech fell to 4-1 and 1-1.

Ethan Grunkemeyer threw for more than 400 yards, only the third time a Virginia Tech quarterback has done that in the program’s recorded history. His 28-yard touchdown to Davion Brown with 10:07 left cut the lead to 35-33. He then drove the Hokies 62 yards to Love’s kick. The kick was ruled wide. The win, and the argument about the kick, are both why the game is being searched.

posts.title: Pak vs Ind
posts.headline: India post 211 for 6 against Pakistan in the Asian Games final
posts.dek: The gold-medal match is in Nisshin. Tilak Varma and Shivam Dube lifted India late. Pakistan’s target is 212.
posts.angle: A gold-medal final in Japan. India batted first and made 211 for 6.

blocks.text: India and Pakistan are playing the men’s cricket final at the Asian Games in Nisshin, Japan. India won the toss, batted, and reached 211 for 6. Tilak Varma and Shivam Dube did the late damage after India had slowed in the middle overs. Pakistan need 212 to take the gold.
What is already on the scorecard

Abhishek Sharma made 61 off 28 balls. Varma was not out on 50 off 21. Dube made 27. Shreyas Iyer, the captain, made 21. The ground is Korogi Sports Park. The match is a T20. Those are the facts that were settled when India’s innings closed. The chase is the part people are refreshing.

A final between these two teams does not need a finished chase to own a search bar in the United States. The score to know, as India’s batting ended, is 211 for 6. Anything after that belongs to the live page, not to a sentence written before the last ball.

posts.title: Valkyries
posts.headline: The Valkyries win their first playoff series
posts.dek: Golden State came back from 16 points down against Dallas and reached the WNBA semifinals in the franchise’s first try.
posts.angle: Down 16 to the Wings, then into the semifinals.

blocks.text: The Golden State Valkyries have won a playoff series. They erased a 16-point deficit against the Dallas Wings and advanced to the WNBA semifinals. It is the first playoff series in franchise history, and it is the first time the club has gone this far.
Why the name is the search

The Valkyries are a new team. A first series win is the whole identity of the search: not a veteran club adding another round, but a franchise that did not have a playoff win until this one. The comeback is the detail attached to it. Sixteen points is a hole. They climbed out of it against Dallas.

The semifinals are next. The series that got them there is the one people are opening. Golden State is no longer waiting on a first playoff win. Dallas is the team that was in front by 16 and is now out.

posts.title: Tony Romo
posts.headline: Tony Romo is out as CBS’s NFL analyst
posts.dek: The split follows his July DUI arrest. The network and Romo are reported to have negotiated a settlement. A return somewhere else is already being guessed at.
posts.angle: CBS and Romo are done. The arrest is why.

blocks.text: Tony Romo is out as the NFL analyst for CBS Sports. The departure follows his arrest on a DUI charge in July. CBS and Romo negotiated a contract settlement. The history of this job is that a former quarterback often finds another booth.
What has been settled

He is no longer CBS’s NFL voice. The arrest is the event the coverage ties to the exit. A settlement means the contract did not simply run out on a quiet afternoon. It was negotiated to an end. The criminal case is a separate track from the television job, and the headlines are about the job.

People searching his name want two answers: is he off CBS, and is that permanent. The first answer is yes. The second is only about CBS. Nothing in the reporting says he has signed somewhere else. It says the door at that network is closed.

posts.title: Kathleen Turner
posts.headline: Michael Douglas says he and Kathleen Turner were lovers
posts.dek: He described a secret relationship during Romancing the Stone. She answered, four decades later, with “Good heavens.”
posts.angle: A secret from Romancing the Stone, said out loud 40 years later.

blocks.text: Michael Douglas has said that he and Kathleen Turner were secret lovers. He put the relationship in the years of Romancing the Stone. Turner’s reported reaction, forty years on, was “Good heavens.” The affair is the story. Neither of them had put it on the record this way before.
What each of them has said

Douglas described it as a secret romance, and the interview was treated as a first telling. Turner did not deny the account in what followed. Her line is the one being quoted, short and startled, which is why her name is the search even though he is the one who spoke first.

Romancing the Stone is the film people already know them from. The new fact is that Douglas says the partnership on screen was also a private relationship, kept quiet at the time. That is the sentence the search is trying to confirm. The coverage says he said it, and that she answered.

posts.title: Montana State vs Idaho
posts.headline: Idaho ends Montana State’s 19-game win streak, 35-34
posts.dek: The Vandals scored on a two-point conversion on the last play. The No. 1 Bobcats had not lost in 19 straight.
posts.angle: Idaho 35, Montana State 34, on the final play.

blocks.text: Idaho beat No. 1 Montana State 35-34 on Friday night. The winning points were a two-point conversion on the last play. The result ended a 19-game winning streak for the Bobcats, who had gone to Moscow for a Friday night game and left with their first loss of that run.
One play, and a ranking

A two-point try on the final snap is the whole margin. Idaho did not win by a late field goal or a long drive that still left time. The game ended on the conversion. Montana State was the top-ranked team in the subdivision and had won 19 in a row. Both of those descriptions stopped on the same play.
The score is 35-34. The streak is over. The search is the upset, and the fact that it was decided after a touchdown rather than by the touchdown itself.

posts.title: Francia - Italia
posts.headline: France and Italy drew 1-1. Donnarumma is the other half of the night.
posts.dek: The same Nations League match, searched in Spanish. Olise scored. Italy answered. Zidane said there was not a real contest, and promised the crowd something else.
posts.angle: The 1-1 again, this time through Zidane’s promise and Donnarumma.

blocks.text: This is the same Nations League night as the English-language search, typed the way much of the football world types it. France 1, Italy 1. Michael Olise scored. Italy matched it. Gianluigi Donnarumma is the name the Spanish coverage keeps next to the draw: a goalkeeper who kept one French goal from becoming a win.
What Zidane added

In the Spanish reporting, Zidane went further than “we deserved more.” He said there had not been a real contest against Italy, and he made a promise to the supporters. That is a different temperature from a mild post-match credit to the opponent’s defense, and it is why this spelling of the match is traveling on its own.
The score does not change between languages. It is 1-1. Olise was not enough. Italy left with a point. The argument Zidane started afterward is the part this search is actually for.

posts.title: Colleen Hoover Verity Movie
posts.headline: Verity opens at $32 million. Digger does not.
posts.dek: Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson lead Colleen Hoover’s thriller. Tom Cruise’s Digger opened at $10 million, his lowest start in 19 years.
posts.angle: Verity did $32 million. The other wide release did $10 million.

blocks.text: Verity, the Colleen Hoover adaptation with Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson, opened at $32 million. That is a solid start, a little under the $35 million the tracking had aimed at earlier in the week, and enough to be the movie people are searching by the author’s name. Digger, the Tom Cruise film in the other wide slot, opened at $10 million, his lowest opening in 19 years.
The movie people are arguing about

The early reviews have not moved. Hathaway is the performance they say carries it. The film is camp, it is faithful to the book, and more than one review thinks it should have been stranger. Hoover’s readers already had a side. A $32 million opening means a large number of them bought a ticket anyway.

The search pairs the author and the title because that is how the book was known. The new number is the opening. Verity did $32 million. Digger did $10 million. The weekend’s argument has a winner at the box office, and it is not Cruise.

posts.title: Surinam - Guatemala
posts.headline: Suriname and Guatemala drew 0-0 in Paramaribo
posts.dek: Guatemala spent a half under pressure and left with a point. Suriname stayed top of the Nations League group.
posts.angle: Suriname 0, Guatemala 0. A point that both teams can use.

blocks.text: Suriname and Guatemala drew 0-0 in the Concacaf Nations League on Friday in Paramaribo. The match was at Dr. Ir. Franklin Essed Stadium, on matchday three of League A Group B. Guatemala spent much of the first half defending and still left with a point. Luis Fernando Tena had said before kickoff that this Suriname side is better than last year’s.
What the point does

Suriname remain first in the group on seven points. Guatemala have four. The top two in the group advance, along with the pre-seeded sides. A 0-0 on the road is not a performance people clip for the goals. It is a result Guatemala’s coverage called a valuable point, and it is why the match is being searched after a night with no score.
The final is 0-0. Suriname had the first half. Guatemala had the point. The return game is in Guatemala.

posts.title: Greg Lui Doj Charges
posts.headline: Federal agents arrested Greg Lui in an alleged $300 million smuggling case
posts.dek: Prosecutors say the California man sent about $300 million in AI hardware to China. He has been arrested. He has not been convicted.
posts.angle: An arrest, a $300 million allegation, and servers that prosecutors say went to China.

blocks.text: Federal agents have arrested Greg Lui, a California man, in a case that accuses him of smuggling about $300 million in AI hardware to China. The goods are described as computer servers and as AI tech. The charge is an allegation. An arrest is not a conviction.
What prosecutors are saying

The Justice Department’s account, as reported, is that a smuggling scheme moved roughly $300 million in hardware out of the United States to China. That number is why a name most people had not typed before is now a national search. Export cases of this size are about what was shipped, who arranged it, and whether the law required a license that was not there.

Lui has been arrested in California. The next step is a court, not a headline. Until a plea or a verdict, the accurate sentence is the one the charging documents support: the government says he smuggled about $300 million in AI hardware to China, and he is in custody on that accusation.

posts.title: Shivon Zilis
posts.headline: Shivon Zilis says Elon Musk ended their relationship with no warning
posts.dek: She was his longtime business confidante and the mother of four of his children. She says he let her go abruptly.
posts.angle: She says the split came with no warning.

blocks.text: Shivon Zilis says Elon Musk ended their relationship abruptly and with no warning. She has been described as his longtime business confidante and as the mother of four of his children. The split is being reported as Musk letting go of a partner and co-parent. Her account is that it happened without notice.
What she has said, and what the record is

The public fact is her statement. She says the relationship is over and that she was not given a warning. The coverage identifies her as both a business partner in his orbit and a co-parent. Those roles are why a private split is being searched under her name rather than only under his.

Nothing in the reporting is a filing or a company announcement. It is her description of how it ended. He has not, in the headlines driving the search, given a matching public account. The story as it stands is hers: no warning, and an abrupt end.

posts.title: Doing Life Tyler Perry
posts.headline: Tyler Perry’s Doing Life is streaming on Netflix
posts.dek: The series is out. The early review calls its central figure a mysterious hero. A Dayton actor is in the cast people are looking up.
posts.angle: A new Tyler Perry series, already playing, and a cast people are naming.

blocks.text: Tyler Perry’s Doing Life is on Netflix, and it is already streaming. That is why the title is being searched as news rather than as a coming-soon page. The early review describes a mysterious hero. The rest of the search is the cast: who is in it, and which faces people recognize.
What the coverage has actually said

A Dayton native is in the series, which is the local piece of a national query. The show is Perry’s, it is a drama, and it is available now. The review’s frame is a hero whose story is not handed to the audience in the first scene. That is as far as the public description needs to go for the search to make sense.
If you typed the title, the answer is that it is out. Netflix has it. Perry’s name is on it. The cast lists are the other tab people open once they know the show exists.

posts.title: El Salvador vs Jamaica
posts.headline: Jamaica beat 10-man El Salvador, 2-0
posts.dek: Javon East scored both goals. El Salvador’s Rudy Clavel was sent off in the 20th minute. Jamaica moved into second in the group.
posts.angle: El Salvador 0, Jamaica 2. East scored twice.

blocks.text: Jamaica beat El Salvador 2-0 in the Concacaf Nations League at Estadio Cuscatlán in San Salvador. Javon East scored both goals, in the 39th minute and again in the 64th. El Salvador played more than an hour with 10 men after Rudy Clavel was shown a straight red card in the 20th minute for a late challenge on East.
The two goals

East’s first came from close range after Miguel Freckleton put the ball into the box. His second was a first-time finish set up by substitute Jahmarie Nolan, who won the ball inside the area. Jamaica controlled the match after the red card and after the break. The win puts the Reggae Boyz on six points, second in the group, one behind Suriname. They finish the group against Honduras on Monday.
The score is 2-0. The scorer is East, twice. The red card is the reason El Salvador spent the night short a player.

posts.title: Dylan Larkin
posts.headline: Dylan Larkin is on injured reserve, and Detroit booed him anyway
posts.dek: The Red Wings captain was headed to IR before the opener. Fans booed him, then chanted for the team to be sold. He had told the club he would take it.
posts.angle: Injured, booed, and a captain who said he would absorb it.

blocks.text: Dylan Larkin is going on injured reserve. Before the Detroit Red Wings’ opener, the fans booed him loudly. Minutes into the game they chanted for the owner to sell the team. Detroit lost. Larkin had already told the organization he would take the abuse.
The captain and the building

An IR move means he is out of the lineup for the stretch the roster move covers. The booing happened anyway, which is why his name is being searched separately from the score. The reporting says he expected it and said so inside the team. That is a captain volunteering to be the face of a bad night rather than a player surprised by one.

The opener ended in a loss, with a sell-the-team chant before the game had really started. Larkin’s injury and the crowd’s reaction are the same story. He is hurt. They were angry. He said he would carry it.

posts.title: Jed York
posts.headline: The NFL suspended Jed York six games and fined him $500,000
posts.dek: The 49ers owner was arrested in a prostitution sting after responding to a fake ad. The league called it a personal-conduct violation.
posts.angle: Six games, $500,000, and an arrest the league did not ignore.

blocks.text: The NFL has suspended San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York for six games and fined him $500,000. The penalty is for violating the personal conduct policy. York had been arrested in a prostitution sting after responding to a fake advertisement. The suspension and the fine are the league’s answer. The arrest is the reason.
What the punishment covers

Six games is a stretch of the season, not a one-week gesture. Half a million dollars is the fine attached to it. Owners are rarely the person in a conduct story. York is, and the accounts agree: the arrest happened, the league reviewed it, and this is the result.

The criminal case and the NFL penalty are not the same proceeding. The search is the suspension, because that is what changes the season. He is out for six games. The club is fined through him. The arrest that started it was a sting built on a fake ad.

posts.title: Bruins vs Jets
posts.headline: JJ Peterka wins it for Boston in overtime, 4-3
posts.dek: The Bruins came back late against Winnipeg. Peterka’s overtime goal was his second game-winner in two nights.
posts.angle: Boston 4, Winnipeg 3, in overtime.

blocks.text: The Boston Bruins beat the Winnipeg Jets 4-3 in overtime on October 2. JJ Peterka scored the winner. It was his second game-winning goal in two games. The Bruins had to come back late to force the extra period at all.
Two nights, two winners

A new Bruin who already has two overtime winners is the reason his line is being pulled out of a 4-3 game. The Jets led the night into a position where Boston needed a late push. They got it, and Peterka ended it. The recaps agree on the score and on who scored the last goal.
The final is 4-3, overtime. The goal is Peterka’s. Two games into his Boston story, both of them have ended with him.

posts.title: Beta Pictoris B Radio Emission
posts.headline: Astronomers heard a planet outside the solar system
posts.dek: The signal is radio from Beta Pictoris b. It is the first detection of its kind. It is not a message from anyone.
posts.angle: A first radio detection from an exoplanet. Not aliens.

blocks.text: Astronomers have reported the first radio signal detected from a planet outside our solar system. The planet is Beta Pictoris b. The accounts of the detection are explicit about what it is not: it is not aliens. It is a natural radio emission, the kind a planet can produce, heard at a distance for the first time.
Why the search jumped

Any headline with “radio signal” and a planet invites the wrong reading. The waves are being called a possible cosmic first: radio from a planet beyond the solar system. The scientific claim is the first. The correction, printed in the same wave of coverage, is that nobody is transmitting.
Beta Pictoris b is the object. Radio is the wavelength. The detection is new because this kind of signal had not been picked up from an exoplanet before. That is the story. A message it is not.

posts.title: Colombia vs Paraguay
posts.headline: Colombia meet Paraguay without James Rodríguez
posts.dek: It is a friendly on the FIFA date. Néstor Lorenzo said before kickoff that the team is not put together yet.
posts.angle: A friendly, no James, and a coach who said the side is unfinished.

blocks.text: Colombia are playing Paraguay in a friendly on this FIFA window, and James Rodríguez is not in the side. The search riding next to the match is who plays the No. 10 without him. Coach Néstor Lorenzo, speaking before the game, was blunt about the state of the group: the team is not assembled yet.
A lineup, not a final

The pages driving the American search are live pages and previews, not a settled recap. Lorenzo’s line is the quote. James’s absence is the fact. Paraguay are the opponent. A friendly can still fill a search bar when the creative player people associate with the national team is missing and the coach says the replacement side is unfinished.

Treat the score as live. The part that was true before kickoff, and that the coverage agrees on, is the absence and the coach’s verdict. Colombia are looking for another 10. Lorenzo does not think the team is built.

posts.title: Ducks vs Golden Knights
posts.headline: Anaheim led by four, then held on to beat Vegas 4-3
posts.dek: The Ducks built the lead early. The Golden Knights made a late game of it. Anaheim still won.
posts.angle: Anaheim 4, Vegas 3. The lead was four before it got nervous.

blocks.text: The Anaheim Ducks beat the Vegas Golden Knights 4-3 on October 2. They led by four goals early. Vegas rallied late and made the final score look like a one-goal game. Anaheim held on.
A lead that almost left

Four goals up is the kind of advantage that usually ends a night. It did not feel that way by the end. The recap and the box both land on 4-3, Ducks. The comeback is Vegas’s part of the story. The win is Anaheim’s. A late rally that stops one goal short is why both fan bases are still typing the score.
The final is 4-3. Anaheim scored four before the game turned into a chase. Vegas got three of them back and did not get the fourth.

posts.title: Dallas Stars
posts.headline: The Blues shut out the Stars, 4-0
posts.dek: One game into the season, Dallas is already being asked the old question about its offense. St. Louis did not allow a goal.
posts.angle: St. Louis 4, Dallas 0, on opening night.

blocks.text: The St. Louis Blues beat the Dallas Stars 4-0 on October 2. It was a shutout in the Stars’ first game of the season. The coverage the next morning was not about a fluke save or a single bad period. It was the familiar question about Dallas’s offense, asked again after one night.
A zero on the board

Four goals against and none for is a complete result. The recap lists it as Blues 4, Stars 0. A shutout on opening night does not decide a season, and it does decide the conversation for a week. Dallas was supposed to score. St. Louis did not let them.
The search is the team name because the result is the kind that sends people to the roster. The score answers them first. It is 4-0, St. Louis.

posts.title: Chip City
posts.headline: Chip City closed every store
posts.dek: The Queens-founded cookie chain shut all of its locations at once. A legal dispute is part of the account. Police collected evidence at the Upper West Side shop.
posts.angle: Every location is closed. The shutdown was abrupt.

blocks.text: Chip City, the cookie chain that started in Queens, has closed all of its stores. The shutdown was abrupt. Reporting in New York describes a legal dispute around the closure. At the Upper West Side shop, NYPD officers arrived to collect evidence.
What customers found

A chain does not usually go dark in every neighborhood on the same day unless something has already broken. That is the shape of this story. The stores are closed. The company people knew as a cookie counter is not serving. The legal dispute is the explanation being reported, not a verdict, and the police visit at one location is why the closure is not being written as a quiet business decision.

If the search is whether a particular Chip City is open, the answer from the coverage is no. All of them shut. The dispute, and whatever officers took from the Upper West Side store, is the part still being sorted.

posts.title: Bruce Willis
posts.headline: Bruce Willis’s family marked another step in his dementia
posts.dek: A rare photo shows him with his daughter. His wife, Emma, said the diagnosis will not be in vain and called this the next chapter.
posts.angle: A rare photo, and his wife’s account of what comes next.

blocks.text: Bruce Willis has been seen in a rare photo with his daughter, and his wife, Emma, has spoken again about his dementia. She said the diagnosis will not be in vain. In a separate tribute she called this the next chapter of his life and referred to him as her legend. The illness is not new. The photograph and her words are.
What the family has shared

The public record of his condition has come from the family for years, not from a clinic’s press release. This round is a picture and a statement. Emma Heming Willis is the person speaking. The photo is being treated as rare because he has not been in public view. That scarcity is the reason a single image is a national search.

There is no new medical bulletin in the headlines beyond what she chose to say: the diagnosis stands, it will not be wasted, and the family is in another chapter of it. The photo is the evidence that he is still with them. The rest stays where she left it.

posts.title: Liberty vs Delaware
posts.headline: Liberty beat Delaware 30-14 and led 30-0
posts.dek: Kam Davis ran for 147 yards and two touchdowns. Delaware’s points all came in the fourth quarter, after the game was decided.
posts.angle: Liberty 30, Delaware 14. The Flames led by 30.

blocks.text: Liberty beat Delaware 30-14 on Friday night in Newark, in the Conference USA opener for both teams. Kam Davis rushed for 147 yards and two touchdowns. Liberty led 30-0 before Delaware scored. The Blue Hens’ 14 points all came in the fourth quarter.
How the lead was built

Davis scored from 56 yards in the second quarter and from 5 yards early in the fourth, the second of those making it 30-0. He had 123 of his yards before halftime. Chase Reeves kicked three field goals, two of them in the first quarter. Peyton Jones’s 3-yard run in the final minute of the half, at the end of a 98-yard drive, made it 20-0 at the break. Deshawn Purdie completed 13 of 20 passes for 157 yards.

Liberty came in as the only FBS team that had not allowed a fourth-quarter point this season. That distinction ended. Delaware backups Braden Streeter and Tyler Bell threw touchdown passes in the last 10 minutes, including a 58-yard score. It changed the scoreboard to 30-14 and did not change the winner. Liberty is 4-1 and 1-0 in the league. Delaware is 2-3 and 0-1. The announced crowd was 19,182.
